name: The St. Regis Bermuda Resort
insider_take: This ultra-luxe resort sits majestically on the pristine shores of St. Catherine's Beach in UNESCO World Heritage St. George's - Bermuda's historic first settlement and former capital.
whats_special: The St. Regis Bermuda is the island's newest luxury resort, featuring the signature St. Regis Butler Service and exclusive access to one of Bermuda's most secluded pink sand beaches. You're staying in a living museum - St. George's boasts 400+ years of history with perfectly preserved colonial architecture and cobblestone streets that predate Jamestown.
pro_tip: Book the Royal Suite for panoramic ocean views and request your butler arrange a private sunset cruise to explore the nearby crystal caves and shipwreck sites that dot St. George's historic harbor.
dont_miss: Explore St. Peter's Church (1612) - the oldest continuously used Anglican church in the Western Hemisphere, just minutes away. The resort's prime location also puts you steps from the historic Town Square where Shakespeare's "The Tempest" was inspired by Bermuda's shipwreck tales.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with direct beach access
Luxurious St. Regis signature butler service
Exceptional dining options with ocean views
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
